verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a general report builder (joining and pivoting data, calculated fields), compensation-trend reporting, and pay-run comparison. These suggest payroll data can be reported on, but nothing names payroll registers or gross-to-net reports, and no export is documented. missing for 10: explicit payroll register report, gross-to-net report, documented export (CSV/Excel) of payroll reports, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can generate payroll registers and gross-to-net reports and export them for analysis

citations.quote: It’s easy to join and pivot data, build calculated fields, and more.
Monitor global compensation trends by department, location, and more
compare your current pay run with previous ones to catch discrepancies before final approval
